correctness.rationale: AGZ v2 §6.2.3 and Prop. 6.8 give the four fibers, Picard rank 20 and determinant 48. Its Lemmas 7.4 and 7.6–7.8 identify the SNC source with the transcendental lattice of a component birational to Y₂, and give an integral pairing-preserving injection into A₂ of index four. This specialization is not AGZ's other map π_* to the Kummer surface, which scales the pairing by two. The stated vanishing orders of the degree-eight Weierstrass coefficient at I₀*, I₀*, IV, IV* sum to at least nine, so f=0 and the automorphism x↦ζ₃x acts on H²,⁰ by ζ₃. Together with its conjugate this is the whole complexification of the rank-two T. As a torsion-free rank-one module over the Eisenstein integers, T is free. Isometry in the basis v,Rv gives equal squared norms and mixed product −(v,v)/2, so the Gram matrix is mG and 3m²=48 gives m=4. Its Smith factors are 4 and 12. In A₂, half the norm is a²−ab+b² and is odd on every nonzero residue class modulo 2. The specialization image must then lie in 2A₂, and equality follows from the indices. The quotient is (ℤ/2)², only on transcendental lattices. Replay: RESULT.md Steps 1–3 plus AGZ §§6.2.3, 7; verify_lattice.py and VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not run. The seven-HNF check would verify the lattice arithmetic, not the geometric premises.

originality.rationale: The strongest antecedent is a direct prior implication in AGZ Prop. 6.8, not merely an order-four count. In its proof π:Y₂⇢X has π_*π^*=[2] on T_X, T_X=A₂(2), and π_* scales the form by 2. The conclusion α=2 says [T_X:π_*T_{Y₂}]=4. Hence 2T_X⊆π_*T_{Y₂} has the same index and equals it. In the scaled-image basis π_*T_{Y₂}=2T_X has form 8G, so T_{Y₂} already follows as 4G. The specialization embedding of AGZ Lemmas 7.4, 7.6–7.8 then has only one possible image: even a basis vector of squared norm 8 in A₂ reduces to zero mod 2, by the three nonzero residues of a²−ab+b². With index four this forces 2A₂, and the quotient and Smith factors are immediate. AGZ does not spell out the quotient in the inspected portions, but its established maps give the whole invariant by containment, equal indices and this elementary parity check. The alternative automorphism proof does not establish an uncovered stronger result.
residual_risks: A catalogue may additionally spell out the exact source type; it was not available at full-text level. The rejection rests on the affirmative primary-source implication, not the access gap.

value.rationale: The distinction between a cyclic and an elementary abelian obstruction is mathematically meaningful, but for this particular map it is already fixed by the two published integral-lattice descriptions. The frozen result adds a longer route to the source Gram matrix and extracts its immediate local and Smith-form consequences; it does not settle a separate invariant still undetermined by the published maps. It makes no claim about the full integral cohomology cokernel.
